medicare.eligibility_note: Must be entitled to Medicare Part A, enrolled in Part B, and live in the service area (Clark, Cowlitz, King, Kitsap, Pierce, Snohomish, Spokane and Thurston counties, WA).
medicare.extra_help_note: With Extra Help (Low-Income Subsidy) the Part D deductible is $0 and you pay $5.80/$14.40, $1.65/$5.00 or $0 per drug until the $2,400 out-of-pocket limit, depending on your level. The figures here are for people without Extra Help.

dental_preventive.frequency_limit: Exams, cleanings (up to 2 per year), bitewing x-rays (1 per year) and other diagnostic/preventive items $0. Counts toward the $1,000 combined yearly maximum.
details: $0 copay for emergency diagnostic exam, periodic oral exam and cleaning, up to 2 per year.
$0 copay for comprehensive oral evaluation or periodontal exam, up to 1 every 3 years.
$0 for bitewing x-rays (1 per year), intraoral x-rays (6 per year), panoramic film (1 every 5 years).
Out of network the same cost shares are listed, but the provider may balance-bill and benefits are subject to in-network limits.

dental_comprehensive.frequency_limit: $1,000 combined maximum per year for all diagnostic/preventive and comprehensive dental; frequencies vary by service.
details: 50% of the cost: fillings (1 per tooth surface every 2 years), scaling and root planing (1 per quadrant every 3 years), crowns and core buildup (1 per tooth every 5 years), bridges (1 every 5 years), root canal or extraction (1 per tooth per lifetime), anesthesia.
0% of the cost: crown recementation (1 every 2 years), root canal retreatment, bridge recementation, oral surgery (up to 2 per year), periodontal maintenance (up to 4 per year).

eye_exam_routine.frequency_limit: One routine exam per year; $75 combined maximum benefit per year for the routine exam.

eyewear.frequency_limit: $50 per year for contact lenses or eyeglass lenses and frames and fitting ($100 at a PLUS provider, in network only); one-time use per year; amounts cannot be combined. Eyewear after cataract surgery is $0.

hearing_exam_routine.frequency_limit: One routine hearing exam and fitting per year; three follow-up provider visits per year. Out of network you pay the full cost and are reimbursed up to 5% of the allowed amount.

in_network.limits: $575 per Level 1 hearing aid; $750 per Level 2 hearing aid.

hearing_aids.frequency_limit: Up to 1 hearing aid per ear per year. Includes 3 years of batteries (non-rechargeable) and a 3-year warranty.
details: $575 copay for each Level 1 prescription hearing aid; $750 copay for each Level 2 hearing aid.
Medicare-covered hearing services are a $45 copay.
SilverSneakers fitness program, $0 copay. Out of network 95% coinsurance and a 5% reimbursement.

meals.frequency_limit: After an inpatient stay: 2 home-delivered meals per day for 7 days (up to 14 meals); limited to 4 times per year; request within 30 days of discharge.
details: Humana Well Dine meal program, $0 copayment.
Emergency ambulance $325 per date of service; emergency room $130; urgent care $50. Outside the U.S. you pay up front and request reimbursement.

notes: Premium is per person. For a couple, each spouse needs a plan, so double the annual premium and the out-of-pocket exposure (the app currently doubles individual amounts for a married couple).
Medical deductible is $0, so every in-network service pays its copay or coinsurance from the first dollar.

Several services have a price per site of service (imaging, X-ray, diagnostic tests, surgery). The file holds one site per service; the others are in each service's limits text. Adjust Evaluator prices if you use a different site.
Part D has its own $700 deductible for tiers 3 to 5 and a $2,400 prescription out-of-pocket cap (limits.drug_deductible, limits.drug_oop_max).
Out-of-network cost shares are recorded in out_of_network_services; the evaluator costs in-network use.

assumptions: Source is the 2027 Summary of Benefits only; the Evidence of Coverage was not read.
The drug tier fields hold the retail pharmacy, 30-day amounts; all six pharmacy columns (retail, standard mail order, preferred mail order, each 30 and 100 days) are in drugs.pharmacy_channels.

Where a price differs by site of service, the file uses: freestanding radiological facility for X-rays ($40) and advanced imaging ($205), specialist's office for diagnostic tests ($45), ambulatory surgery center for surgery ($350), and a diabetic supplier for diabetic supplies (20%). Other sites are in each limits text.
service_area lists King County only (the county of the other plan files); the plan also serves Clark, Cowlitz, Kitsap, Pierce, Snohomish, Spokane and Thurston.
Skilled nursing: $221 per day for days 21-100 is entered with max_units 80; the $10 per day for days 1-20 is not modeled.
Dental: the $1,000 yearly maximum covers preventive and comprehensive dental together, so cleanings count toward it. It is treated as per person.
notes: Plan ID H5216-428 comes from the document code H5216428001 (contract H5216, plan 428, segment 001).
Medical maximum out-of-pocket is $6,050 in network and $10,750 combined in and out of network.
Home health, surgeon fees and hospital physician fees are not listed in the Summary of Benefits, so they are 'unknown'.
The Summary of Benefits gives no Star Rating, Part B premium or plan page URL, so they are left out.
